name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport began unconventionally – not on the track, but behind the scenes. Growing up in Belgrade, he was always fascinated by the complex systems that kept things moving, whether it was the city's public transport or the inner workings of his father's repair shop. This fascination led him to logistics, and after graduating, he sought a way to combine his passion with his professional skills. 

He sees his role as more than just moving equipment from point A to point B. Nikola believes in meticulous planning, clear communication, and anticipating potential problems before they arise. His approach is detail-oriented, ensuring that every piece of equipment arrives at the right place, at the right time, in perfect condition. While he's still early in his motorsport career, Nikola's creative problem-solving and dedication make him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Nikola has a lean build with a focused expression, always looking ready for the next challenge.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas and potential issues.
Has a habit of organizing his workspace multiple times a day, even if it's already tidy.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout the day.
